issues.quote: I played Chopin. Casimir likes Chopin, and it is the music I play best.
issues.fact: O4 says only that she sat at the piano at once and played until he came back. It gives no piece, and no information about how long a piece lasts.
issues.misreading: Naming a specific composer could suggest a piece of known length, so a solver might estimate how long she played from the music and infer a duration the sheet does not give.
